ios.desc:
Rating a movie 7/10 means nothing. Knowing you liked it more than Whiplash but less than Interstellar means everything.

Cini is a movie tracker and film diary that replaces star ratings with quick head-to-head comparisons. Log what you watched, tap how you felt, and answer a few "which did you like more?" questions — your new movie lands exactly where it belongs in your ranked list, with a personal score out of 10.

SWITCH IN 60 SECONDS
• Import your entire Letterboxd or IMDb history — watched films, ratings, watchlist, and custom lists
• One drag-and-drop and your movie diary transfers over
• Export anytime as Letterboxd-compatible CSVs

THE MORE YOU RANK, THE SMARTER IT GETS
• Rec Scores predict how much you'll like movies you haven't seen
• Your Want to Watch list sorts itself by what you'll love most
• A taste profile built on your comparisons — not an average of strangers

BUILT FOR MOVIE NIGHTS WITH FRIENDS
• See what friends scored a movie before you commit your Friday night
• Send recommendations with a note — they land right in their list
• Hearts, comments, and spoiler-safe reviews on every ranking
• Race the leaderboard on films watched, influence, and reviews

YOUR COMPLETE FILM DIARY
• Log every watch and rewatch: when, where, and who with
• Custom lists you can share with anyone
• Find where to stream tonight, or real theater showtimes nearby — IMAX, Dolby, and bargain screenings flagged

No ads. No selling your data. Just your taste, in order.

Movie data provided by TMDB.

quotes.text:
I launched Cini, an iPhone/iPad app for ranking movies and shows.

The goal is simple: help people track what they watch, build a taste profile, and find better things to watch from friends and similar users.

I’m looking for early users and blunt feedback on the UX, ranking flow, and whether it feels fun enough to keep using.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cini-rank-movies-shows/id6778975898
